# Affiliate Review Blog

A comprehensive blog for affiliate reviews, product comparisons, and shopping guides.

## Core Features
- Product Reviews
- Product Comparisons
- Category-based Browsing
- Watchlist Management
- Search Functionality

## Technology Stack
- Next.js (App Router)
- React
- CSS (Vanilla)
- MongoDB (presumably, based on 'models' directory)

## SEO Structure
- Dynamic Metadata
- Sitemap and Robots.txt
- Semantic HTML
